title: Studio shell header: a 48 px three-column grid (app chip, centered pillar switcher, Changes with a count badge and Publish) and the type scale the four pillars share
body:
## Source

Epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446, decisions 2 and 3. Measured on objectui main `a2225f91`: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` renders the shell header element as one flex row — home button, `PackageSwitcher`, a literal "·" span, the pillar links, then `ml-auto` Changes and Publish — at `px-3 py-2` with 12 px link text. The package switcher, the primary navigation and the package actions have equal visual weight, and the strip overflows horizontally on narrow viewports by design.

## Target

The header becomes a 48 px CSS grid with three columns (`1fr auto 1fr`), so the pillar switcher is centered regardless of what the left and right groups weigh:

- **Left.** The home icon button (32 px square), then an app chip: a 24 px rounded tile showing the app's icon on its color (the same icon and color the console Home tile uses for that package; a generic package glyph when the package has no app), the package name at 13 px / 600, a chevron. The chip is the `PackageSwitcher` trigger; the switcher's popover is unchanged.
- **Center.** The pillars as a segmented control: a 3 px padded muted track, 28 px items, the active item on a white (card) surface with a 1 px shadow and its icon in the primary color; inactive items in muted foreground. Items read Data, Automations, Interfaces, then whatever the pillar nav card decides for Access / More.
- **Right.** Changes as an outline button whose pending count is an 18 px primary pill (no "· 3" text); Publish as the primary button. The "nothing to publish" sentence stays as the Publish button's title, not as inline text.
- The "·" separator span is removed.

Shared constants, exported from a small `studio-tokens.ts` (or the existing surface module) and consumed by the other children: item title 18 px / 600; body 13 px; meta 12 px; label 11 px uppercase with 0.06 em tracking; rail width 240 px; rail row 32 px; table row 40 px; aside width 300 px; radius 8 px. Tailwind classes only (`text-[18px]`, `h-8`, `w-60`, `w-[300px]`…); the file exists so four pillars stop restating the numbers.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (shell header, `PackageSwitcher` trigger), a new `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studio-tokens.ts`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` only if a key changes.

## Acceptance

1. At 1280 px the segmented control's center is the viewport's center within 4 px while the left group holds a 14-character package name and the right group holds "Changes · 3" and Publish.
2. The app chip shows the HotCRM icon tile for `app.objectstack.hotcrm` and a generic tile for a package with no app.
3. The pending count renders as a pill; with zero pending the pill is absent and Publish is the outline variant it already uses.
4. `StudioDesignSurface.changesCount-11787.test.tsx`, `publishCount-11807`, `pillarNavGuard`, `zhPillarNames-11801` and `createAppAccessibleName` stay green; any that assert the "·" separator or the "Changes · N" text are updated in the same PR, each ablated once.
5. Before/after screenshots at 1280 px, light and dark.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no inline style, so `.dark` stays a real variant.
- Existing `data-testid`s (`studio-nav-more` until the pillar nav card removes it) and i18n keys stay.
- Gates: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `lint`, `build`.
- The objectstack pin bump is not part of this card.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12446
